findings.title: A prepared cradle makes the infant's acknowledgment public
findings.claim: The cradle scene turns a contested infant into an upright, intelligible declarant whose acknowledgment can stabilize the social claim that the surrounding accusation had left uncertain.
findings.mechanism: The prepared and leveled cradle, child, exchanged speech, upright standing, and acknowledging branch cluster converges across 19:26-19:29 and returns to straightness at 19:36.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus verse can be read as the culmination of a public clarification: worship is commanded after embodied speech and acknowledgment have made the relation legible.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-level resonance, not a replacement for the primary translation and not a claim that the lexical branches independently prove a complete christological argument.

epistemic.reason: The channel evidence is trusted and coordinate-specific; the resulting scene-level synthesis remains a qualified macro reading.

branch_activations.carrier: The cradle is the physical carrier for the infant's unexpected public response.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The next word describes the child rather than an abstract proposition.
branch_activations.activation: The prepared cradle supplies a stable platform on which the infant's utterance can be received as a public event.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness at the focus can gather a prepared scene in which the infant's declaration is made socially legible.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch contributes scene preparation only; it does not by itself determine the doctrine of the declaration.

branch_activations.carrier: The leveled resting place makes the scene ordered and accessible rather than chaotic.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The child is presented in an explicitly prepared setting.
branch_activations.activation: Physical leveling becomes the scene-level carrier for a declaration that can be heard without interpretive disorder.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The straight path resonates with an ordered presentation that exposes the contested matter rather than hiding it.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual image and cannot be promoted to a new translation of sirat or mustaqim.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Canlı ya da cansız bir varlık dik konuma gelir veya dik durumda bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus straightness word is the direct focus carrier for upright standing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The infant's appearance before the community supplies the public scene in which standing is read as presence and testimony.
branch_activations.activation: Physical uprightness links the prepared cradle to an exposed, answerable presence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus path is not merely an abstract line; it is the upright course by which a contested claim is made present.
branch_activations.boundary: The contextual standing image does not erase the ordinary road sense of sirat.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: meaningful speech exchanged with an interlocutor
branch_activations.carrier: The infant's speech is the event that answers the community's accusation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The contextual word for meaningful exchange is joined to the infant's actual address.
branch_activations.activation: Speech converts an otherwise inaccessible scene into an intelligible public exchange.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The command to worship follows a path of clarified relation rather than silent assertion.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch supports public intelligibility only and does not specify the content of every later theological implication.

branch_activations.carrier: The child category marks the speaker as socially unexpected and dependent.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The surrounding speech event gives the child an otherwise impossible public role.
branch_activations.activation: Childhood heightens the evidentiary force of the utterance because the speaker is not expected to carry the dispute.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The straight course includes a reversal in which vulnerability becomes the vehicle of clarification.
branch_activations.boundary: The child image does not independently entail a claim about divine status.

branch_activations.carrier: The settled eye and the ensuing silence prepare acknowledgment rather than panic.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Mary is instructed to let the later speech establish the matter.
branch_activations.activation: Acknowledgment is staged as the result of disciplined withholding and subsequent intelligible declaration.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Lordship and worship command arrive after the scene has been stabilized by recognition.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch indicates evidentiary stabilization, not an additional lexical definition of Rabb or abuduhu.

branch_activations.carrier: The prepared setting is an arranged circumstance rather than an accidental backdrop.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Silence, public questioning, and infant speech are sequenced as a managed disclosure.
branch_activations.activation: Preparation makes the later acknowledgment function as a resolution of the accusation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness gathers not only a route but a matter being made ready for correct recognition.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the focus verse into a procedural account of the preceding scene.

findings.title: Provision is prepared, apportioned, and made drinkable
findings.claim: The palm-and-water sequence presents nourishment as managed preparation: fruit is infused, liquid is measured and poured, and milk or syrup is adjusted into a usable drink.
findings.mechanism: The selected branches place dates, water shares, a poured discharge, thickened substance, and diluted milk across the birth scene, then return the pattern to the focus Lordship relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus command can be heard against an economy of provision in which sustaining life involves measured participation rather than raw abundance.
findings.containment: This is a provision-scene resonance across the pericope; it does not replace the primary translation and does not claim that every drink-related branch is a direct semantic facet of Rabb.

epistemic.reason: The channel nomination is trusted and its carriers are exact; the cross-ayah macro synthesis is qualified.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: infusion made by casting into a vessel
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated withdrawal/seclusion carrier frames a vessel-like preparation scene around the birth.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Water and drink are explicitly supplied after the labor crisis.
branch_activations.activation: Casting and steeping become a model for transforming gathered provision into a sustaining form.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The shared Lordship relation is encountered within provision that has been prepared for use.
branch_activations.boundary: The infusion image remains contextual and is not a hidden translation of Lordship.

branch_activations.carrier: The birth and labor carrier marks a concentrated bodily transition before drink is offered.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later provision includes water and a prepared drink rather than an unmediated source.
branch_activations.activation: Dilution becomes an image of making nourishment usable under constrained circumstances.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus Lordship relation is accompanied by practical adaptation that sustains embodied life.
branch_activations.boundary: The preparation image is not a claim about the morphology or literal meaning of the focus words.

branch_activations.carrier: The water offered to Mary is a bounded provision at a moment of bodily need.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding labor scene makes relief and rationing materially relevant.
branch_activations.activation: An allotted share turns mercy into a distributable, finite resource.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The shared Lord relation can be read alongside provision that is common in source but measured in use.
branch_activations.boundary: No claim is made that the focus verse itself denotes allocation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Provision under Lordship includes transformation and stewardship of material resources.
branch_activations.boundary: The resolved facet is used as contextual material imagery, not as a direct gloss of Rabb.

branch_activations.activation: Pouring translates provision from possession into a moment of usable participation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus command sits within a scene where sustaining relation is enacted through concrete delivery.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not support an added imperative in the primary translation.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: an allotted portion or recurring devotional turn
branch_activations.carrier: The later party context carries the notion of a bounded share into the social aftermath.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The birth-scene provision has already shown water as something apportioned for need.
branch_activations.activation: A share can be repeated as a social turn or devotional portion, linking material rationing to communal participation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The shared Lordship relation resists private possession and invites ordered participation.
branch_activations.boundary: The later party carrier is a secondary resonance and does not make the focus verse a ritual scheduling statement.

findings.title: Gift and servanthood close the genealogical route
findings.claim: The surrounding sequence frames Jesus as a bestowed sign and owned servant who names one shared Lord, so worship is directed past the messenger rather than toward divine kinship.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace connects gift, making, sign, servant, worship, and the explicit negation of offspring to the focus words for shared Lordship and worship.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus verse reads as a compact theological redirection: the messenger's status is honored while the route to worship remains the common Lordship relation.
findings.containment: This is a qualified synthesis of exact supplied HFT coordinates; unresolved branches remain attributed and do not receive invented glosses.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record is legacy-unbound but its coordinates, roots, and focus returns agree; unresolved contextual causes are retained only as attributed trace evidence.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The preceding ayah negates offspring language.
branch_activations.activation: Shared ownership supplies the common relation that displaces divine kinship as the governing axis.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Lordship is common and sovereign rather than a party-specific genealogical possession.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch sharpens the relation but does not add an unspoken polemic to the translation.

branch_activations.boundary: The branch has no resolved gloss or facet in the packet and is retained only as an attributed HFT relation.

findings.title: The demonstrative gathers a whole servant life

findings.mechanism: The HFT trace returns through the focus road and straightness branches and attributes exact contextual carriers for servant identity, prayer, almsgiving, filial goodness, non-coercion, and peace.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus demonstrative can be read as pointing to a lived pattern rather than only to assent to a doctrinal sentence.
findings.containment: The trace supports a pericope-level accumulation; unresolved branch glosses remain null and the reading does not replace the primary lexical sense of the focus words.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT coordinates provide a coherent focus return, while several contextual branches remain unresolved and are therefore attributed rather than lexicalized.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderim, üzerinde ilerlenen yoldur.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The straight path is the accumulated course of servant practice.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not require that every preceding narrative detail be a legal obligation.

branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed HFT connection to a resolved branch, not a new translation of the context ayah.

branch_activations.carrier: The context names a transmitted or entrusted charge alongside prayer.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path gathers an entrusted task rather than private spiritual preference.
branch_activations.boundary: The registry marks this branch unresolved, so no lexical gloss is asserted.

branch_activations.carrier: The prayer carrier makes worship a repeated practice within the servant description.

branch_activations.activation: Repeated worship supplies a durable cadence for the straight path.

branch_activations.carrier: The context negates coercive domination in the filial relation.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Servant-life is straight when it does not turn relation into coercive mastery.

branch_activations.carrier: Peace is named across birth, death, and resurrection thresholds.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus path is asserted immediately before the narrative moves to dispute and consequence.
branch_activations.activation: Peace supplies a threshold-spanning endpoint for the lived course.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The straight path gathers not only duties but a mode of passage through mortal transitions.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is unresolved and does not establish an eschatological meaning for the focus by itself.

findings.title: Straightness has a bodily cadence of provision
findings.claim: The straight path can be felt as an embodied sequence: receive what is placed, exert the commanded motion, take provision, become settled, and restrain speech.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace returns through the path and sustaining-straightness branches and links them to exact carriers for running relief, shaking, taking produce, settled eyes, and restrained speech.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus command becomes concrete enough to inhabit: straightness is not only correctness but a disciplined pattern of bodily participation under provision.
findings.containment: This is a qualified analogical reading of the connected birth scene; it does not turn every bodily detail into a direct command or replace the ordinary focus translation.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates and focus returns are exact, but the bodily cadence is an attributed macro synthesis and is therefore bounded as qualified.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: düzleşmiş yol, katranlanmış deve veya kaplanmış gemi

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path stays upright because sustaining means are placed within reach.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness includes receiving timely support rather than treating endurance as self-sufficiency.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved root is retained only through the supplied attributed relation.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness is participatory: the traveler receives by acting within the given order.

branch_activations.carrier: The eye is told to settle after the crisis.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness can require restraint as well as exertion.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains attributed and does not create a general silence obligation.

findings.title: The common path cannot be possessed by a faction
findings.claim: Shared Lordship and one straight path create a common axis that exposes factional routes as a departure from the relation rather than alternate owners of it.
findings.mechanism: The focus branches for shared sovereignty, road, and rectitude are placed against the next ayat's truth, dispute, divergence, party formation, and separation carriers.
findings.reader_payoff: The transition from Jesus's declaration to later disagreement becomes structurally legible: factions arise when they substitute private routes for the common Lord relation.
findings.containment: The finding describes a pericope structure, not a claim that every group disagreement is identical or that the focus verse names a complete sociology of factions.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record has exact focus and consequence coordinates; the macro contrast is qualified because several contextual branches are unresolved.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus establishes one common course against the multiplicity of party paths.
branch_activations.boundary: The road image is structural and does not deny ordinary differences in travel or interpretation.

branch_activations.carrier: The context marks a stable truth claim immediately before the focus.

branch_activations.activation: Truth supplies the stable reference from which factional dispute can be measured.

findings.title: Straightness is tested by the true terminus
findings.claim: The focus road is judged by where it arrives: deviation, closure, missed awareness, provisional possession, and return in 19:38-40 make straightness a terminus-sensitive course.

findings.reader_payoff: The next ayat clarify why the focus path matters: a route is straight not only by appearance but by whether it reaches the proper source and end.
findings.containment: This is a qualified structural reading of the immediate aftermath; it does not make the focus an explicit eschatological sentence or add a translation absent from the ayah.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact focus and aftermath coordinates; the terminus synthesis is qualified because several aftermath branches remain unresolved.

branch_activations.boundary: The route metaphor remains a macro consequence and not a new literal sense.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: düzgünlük, denge ve doğru yoldan sapmama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Doğru yolda kalma, doğru inanç düzeni ve adil söz, düzgünlük çekirdeğinin davranış ve değer alanına uzanmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus adjective is the direct criterion of aligned course.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Deviation, closure, and heedlessness supply negative and terminal contrasts.
branch_activations.activation: Straightness is tested by whether the course remains aligned through completion and awareness.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The proper path holds direction until its true end rather than merely beginning correctly.
branch_activations.boundary: The aftermath does not by itself specify a full doctrine of final judgment.

branch_activations.carrier: The aftermath names deviation as a negative route condition.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus explicitly names a straight path.
branch_activations.activation: Deviation provides the counter-image that makes straightness evaluable.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus route is defined partly by not losing its direction under later perception.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains unresolved and contributes only a bounded contrast.

branch_activations.carrier: The warning ayah marks completion or closure of the available route choices.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus has just presented one straight course.
branch_activations.activation: Closure makes the earlier path declaration consequential rather than ornamental.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A straight path matters because later opportunities to choose are not indefinite.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved carrier is not used to assert a detailed chronology.

branch_activations.carrier: Heedlessness describes missing the relevant endpoint while it is near.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Straightness includes non-deviation and maintained alignment.
branch_activations.activation: Awareness becomes part of staying on the route toward its terminus.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The straight path is not only geometrical; it is a course recognized before its consequences arrive.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch supports attentional contrast only.

branch_activations.carrier: Inheritance is portrayed as an uncontracted or provisional holding.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names the one sovereign owner.
branch_activations.activation: Provisional possession contrasts with the unshared and final ownership of the Lord.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A straight course ends by relinquishing claims to autonomous ownership.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch does not settle the legal meaning of the inheritance statement.

branch_activations.carrier: The closing carrier returns the course to its source endpoint.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus joins road language to one shared Lord.
branch_activations.activation: Return supplies the final terminus for the road and the sovereign relation named at its beginning.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness is the course that arrives back under the true source rather than ending in self-possession.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch is retained as attributed structural evidence only.

findings.title: The path can resonate as incorporation
findings.claim: The road image can extend, exploratorily, into a channel of incorporation: gathered provision passes inward, drink extends the passage, and settledness marks successful uptake.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace returns through the focus passage branch and exact context carriers for gathering, eating, drinking, and settled eyes in the provision scene.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus road gains a bodily interior dimension: a way is not only traversed outward but also becomes a channel through which provision is received.
findings.containment: This is branch-distant exploratory analogy and reader-supplied causal resonance; it must never replace the primary road translation or be treated as a direct lexical meaning.

epistemic.reason: The HFT coordinates are exact, but the incorporation mechanism is analogical and explicitly branch-distant.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: geçişte gözden kaybolmak; özellikle yiyeceği yutmak
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi, özellikle yiyeceği, boğazdan geçirerek yutmak geçişte kaybolma çekirdeğinin doğrudan uygulamasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus road branch supplies the direct path carrier.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Eating and drinking are adjacent acts of inward passage in the provision scene.
branch_activations.activation: The road is analogically extended from traversable surface to channel through which provision disappears inward.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Path can resonate as incorporation when the surrounding scene turns provision into embodied uptake.
branch_activations.boundary: This is explicitly analogical and branch-distant; it is not a translation of sirat.

branch_activations.carrier: Produce is gathered before it is eaten.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus road branch is being extended into a passage model.
branch_activations.activation: Gathering supplies the entry point of a provision route before incorporation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path can include a staged movement from source to mouth to interior.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch is retained as attributed support for analogy only.

branch_activations.carrier: Eating is the literal inward passage in the provision instruction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The resolved swallowing branch supplies the analogical mechanism.
branch_activations.activation: The act of eating gives the path-as-channel image a concrete bodily carrier.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A way can be imagined as successful passage into the recipient rather than only movement across ground.
branch_activations.boundary: The analogy remains reader-supplied and cannot displace the direct focus sense.

branch_activations.carrier: Drinking extends the incorporation sequence beyond solid food.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus road is paired with a swallowing facet in the HFT trace.
branch_activations.activation: Liquid passage makes the inward route continuous and receptive.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path resonance includes different media of provision entering the body.
branch_activations.boundary: No liquid meaning is assigned to the focus word itself.

branch_activations.carrier: Settled eyes mark the point after provision has been received and the crisis quiets.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Incorporation is being read as completed uptake rather than mere entry.
branch_activations.activation: Settledness supplies the reader payoff of a route that has successfully delivered its content.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path-as-incorporation analogy ends in composure and restored capacity.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is unresolved and the entire finding remains exploratory.

findings.title: Straightness echoes continuity through mortal thresholds
findings.claim: The focus road and straightness can, exploratorily, echo a continuity that spans birth, death, and final raising, making the course temporally larger than one present decision.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace returns through the resurrection facet of straightness and the focus road, then connects exact 19:33 carriers for birth, death, and raising.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus path can be sensed as a continuous axis across the life sequence that the surrounding ayat explicitly place between birth and resurrection.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory temporal resonance, not an added eschatological gloss for the focus verse and not a claim that the road word itself denotes resurrection.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact coordinates and a direct focus return, but extending straightness across the birth-death-raising sequence is exploratory.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ölülerin diriltildiği ve insanların yargı için kalktığı gün
branch_activations.facet_statement: Son saat gerçekleşir, ölüler diriltilir ve insanlar yargılanmak üzere ayağa kalkar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus straightness word has an explicit rising and resurrection facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The surrounding context names birth, death, and raising in one temporal sequence.
branch_activations.activation: The straightness axis is extended across the full life-and-raising arc.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path can resonate as continuity that remains legible through mortal thresholds.
branch_activations.boundary: The resurrection facet is used analogically here and does not replace the ordinary focus reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderim, üzerinde ilerlenen yoldur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus road supplies temporal extension for the sequence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The context enumerates life-stage thresholds around the focus.
branch_activations.activation: A road image can connect the successive thresholds as one passage rather than isolated events.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness echoes continuity across the narrative's full temporal horizon.
branch_activations.boundary: The temporal extension is analogical and does not state that every threshold is a separate road.

branch_activations.carrier: The context repeats the day marker across birth, death, and raising.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names a straight road after Jesus's servant declaration.
branch_activations.activation: Repeated temporal markers make a single through-line available for macro resonance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus path can be read as continuous across the repeated day horizons.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved root is retained as attributed sequence evidence only.

branch_activations.carrier: Death supplies the rupture in the temporal passage.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The road and resurrection branches together imply continuity through a break.
branch_activations.activation: The mortal rupture becomes the threshold across which the path's continuity is tested.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness can echo a course that does not terminate at death.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is unresolved and the claim remains exploratory.

branch_activations.carrier: Raising is described as a stirring or standing after death.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus straightness branch includes resurrection and rising.
branch_activations.activation: The final threshold gives the temporal axis an upward completion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The straight path can resonate as an axis that reaches renewed standing.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved carrier does not define the exact eschatological mechanics.

branch_activations.carrier: The context completes the sequence with living animation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Straightness is linked by trace to rising and judgment.
branch_activations.activation: Life after rupture completes the passage that the road analogy tentatively spans.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus course can be sensed as continuity into renewed life.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains an attributed, branch-distant resonance rather than direct semantic evidence.

findings.title: The host invocation frames the focus under named mercy
findings.claim: The automatic host basmala places the focus's naming of Allah within a prior frame of divine naming and mercy.
findings.mechanism: The host Allah occurrence and the two mercy-name occurrences precede the focus Allah carrier and create a local invocation frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's shared Lordship claim is heard inside the chapter's opening address rather than as an isolated assertion.
findings.containment: This automatic host frame is kept separate from candidate evidence and does not add a new translation or import external surah material.

epistemic.reason: The host basmala is an automatic context unit; the finding is a bounded contextual resonance without an independent support record.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Yaratıcıya özgü ad ile seslenme ve ant biçimleri
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: Allah is the named focus carrier in 19:36.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The host basmala names Allah and immediately qualifies the invocation with the two mercy names.
branch_activations.activation: The opening naming frame carries into the focus's shared Lordship assertion.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus is received within an already invoked relation of unique naming and mercy.
branch_activations.boundary: The host frame is contextual only and does not determine the focus's full theological scope.

findings.title: External praise broadens Lordship toward all realms
findings.claim: The phase-two external contact in 1:2 can overlay the focus's shared Lordship with a universal scope reaching all realms.
findings.mechanism: The focus Rabb carrier is placed against the external Rabb phrase and its explicit worlds/realms complement.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's 'my Lord and your Lord' relation can be heard as a shared relation within a wider universal order.
findings.containment: This is an external phase-two overlay only; it is quarantined from the native phase-one field and does not import the whole opening surah.

epistemic.reason: The external contact is an allowed individual reference with direct root and focus contact, but no packet support trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus repeats Rabb for speaker and audience.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: External 1:2 pairs praise of Allah with Rabb of all realms.
branch_activations.activation: The ownership-and-governance branch expands the shared relation toward a universal domain.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's common Lord is not a private local patron but the Lord of every realm.
branch_activations.boundary: The external overlay is supplementary and does not replace the native pericope reading.

findings.title: External judgment adds accountability to Lordship
findings.claim: The phase-two external contact in 1:4 can overlay the focus's shared Lordship with ownership that is accountable across a final day.
findings.mechanism: The focus Rabb carrier is set beside the external owner, day, and judgment-domain terms in 1:4.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus command can be heard as worship under a Lord whose shared governance includes accountability, not only present belonging.
findings.containment: This is an individual external reference retained for genuine delta only; it is not a whole-surah import or a new direct translation of Rabb.

epistemic.reason: The contact is a direct phase-two root and focus overlay without a separate support trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names one shared Lord.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: External 1:4 places ownership within a day and domain of judgment.
branch_activations.activation: Lordship's ownership branch acquires a temporal accountability horizon.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Worship is oriented toward the shared Lord as owner across the final accountable day.
branch_activations.boundary: The external overlay adds horizon only and does not make judgment an explicit noun in 19:36.

findings.title: External devotion clarifies the worship relation
findings.claim: The phase-two external contact in 1:5 overlays the focus imperative with an explicit first-person devotional posture directed to Allah alone.
findings.mechanism: The focus worship carrier is placed against the external first-person worship occurrence and its paired appeal for help.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus command becomes immediately actionable as a shared devotional stance rather than only a proposition about who the Lord is.
findings.containment: This is an external overlay from one individually selected ayah; it supplements the native servant declaration and does not import surrounding surah material.

epistemic.reason: The external contact is direct and individually selected, but no independent packet trust label is supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Merkezî dinsel kullanım, Tanrı'ya yönelen tapınma ve kendini bu yönelişe vermedir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus commands worship of the shared Lord.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: External 1:5 enacts worship and asks help from Allah in the first person plural.
branch_activations.activation: The devotional branch turns the focus imperative into a repeatable communal posture.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Those who name Allah as Lord can also enact shared worship and dependence before him.
branch_activations.boundary: The external overlay does not replace the narrative's third-person command or add its appeal as a missing clause.

findings.title: External guidance makes the straight path a requested course
findings.claim: The phase-two external contacts in 1:6-1:7 overlay the focus road and straightness with a communal request for guidance along a non-deviant path.
findings.mechanism: The focus sirat carrier is paired with the external guidance and path occurrences, while the focus mustaqim carrier is paired with the explicit straight-path request and the negative deviants.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus path can be heard not only as described but as a course communities actively ask to be shown and kept upon.
findings.containment: Only individual external references 1:6 and 1:7 are used for a genuine guidance delta; the whole external surah is quarantined and no external line is treated as native wording.

epistemic.reason: The external references directly contact the focus roots and add a guidance/request dimension, but the packet supplies no external support trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderim, üzerinde ilerlenen yoldur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus road names the course of worship.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: External 1:6-1:7 asks for guidance to a named path.
branch_activations.activation: The road branch gains a communal seeking posture and a direction toward a specified course.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus path can be received as a course for which guidance is actively requested.
branch_activations.boundary: The external request remains an overlay and is not inserted into the focus imperative.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: düzgünlük, denge ve doğru yoldan sapmama
branch_activations.facet_statement: Doğru yolda kalma, doğru inanç düzeni ve adil söz, düzgünlük çekirdeğinin davranış ve değer alanına uzanmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus adjective names non-deviant straightness.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: External 1:7 contrasts the favored path with anger and deviation.
branch_activations.activation: The rectitude branch gains an explicit contrastive field of staying on and falling away from the course.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Straightness becomes a requested alignment against recognizable forms of deviation.
branch_activations.boundary: The external contrast is supplementary and does not identify the focus audience with any external category.

friction_notes: The packet supplies no semantic_obligations field for any candidate; no obligations were synthesized, so all semantic_obligation_refs and semantic_obligation_exclusions arrays are empty.
HFT records are legacy_unbound or reconstructed. Exact coordinates and focus returns support attributed activations, while unresolved branch glosses and facets remain null.

The automatic host basmala at 19:0 was assessed separately. External 1:2, 1:4, 1:5, and 1:6-1:7 were retained only as phase-two individual overlays; 1:3 and non-contact external material were not used.

All nine supplied candidates have dedicated findings. No candidate was represented or rejected, and no branch or facet was excluded because each nominated branch received an activation or, where unresolved, an attributed activation with an explicit boundary.
